name: mascot-studio
description: A 2010s animation studio in your terminal: Clawd acts out what Claude is doing, with usage and music tabs and Windows 7, Mac OS X and Ubuntu themes.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: The 2010s look: auto matches your computer (Windows 7, Mac OS X or Ubuntu)
